name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
how_to:
1. Starting Position: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides or hands on your hips.
2. Step Forward: Take a controlled step forward with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees bend at 90 degrees.
3. Lowering Phase: Keep your torso upright and core engaged as the back knee hovers just above the ground.
4. Push Through Heel: Press through the heel of your front foot to rise and bring the rear leg forward into the next step.
5. Continue Walking: Alternate legs in a smooth, continuous motion until all repetitions are complete.
